ALGER, 28/07/2026 (Algeria Tech) — Le dé: ALGIERS, 07/28/2026 (Algeria Tech) — Developer Ismail presents its mobile application 'Moustafid', an innovative digital tool dedicated to Algerian citizens. The platform promises to facilitate access to administrative services and online procedures.
Lancement d'une nouvelle application mob: Launch of a new mobile application in Algeria
L'entrepreneur Ismail, à l'origine du pr: The entrepreneur Ismail, at the origin of the project, presented his mobile application 'Moustafid' during a video broadcast on YouTube. Officially launched on the occasion of World Environment Day 2024, this technological platform aims to democratize recycling in Algeria.
\"Notre objectif est que l'application M: “Our goal is for the Mostafid application to be present on the smartphone of every Algerian citizen,” underline the project designers, specifying that the solution is available on Android and iOS systems.
Le projet se décline en deux interfaces: The project is divided into two distinct interfaces: the first, intended for the general public, allows individuals to offer their waste for sale, while the second, called "Mostafid Pro", is exclusively reserved for professional collectors.
Le fonctionnement de l'application se ve: The operation of the application is intended to be simple and efficient. In less than sixty seconds, the user can upload their waste for recycling. Once the offer has been published, an approved collector will contact the collector directly by telephone to finalize the recovery operation.
Sur le plan des indicateurs, l’applicati: In terms of indicators, the application is already recording promising dynamics. After nearly two years of development and gradual commissioning, the platform has more than 25,000 active users and a network of more than 200 professional collectors operational in the field.
Au-delà de l’aspect technologique, l’ini: Beyond the technological aspect, the “Mostafid” initiative has a major societal ambition: to bring about a paradigm shift among Algerian citizens. “We want to change the mentality of seeing waste as a burden that must be disposed of. Waste is, in reality, a resource and a potential financial gain,” explain the project promoters.
S’adressant aussi bien aux particuliers: Aimed at both individuals and professionals (pharmacies, factories, businesses), “Mostafid” positions itself as a vector for transport and waste management according to modern and organized standards. This transition to digitalized management of the waste sector is part of the national strategy for ecological transition and promotion of the knowledge economy.
